rules.notes:
• Students in the first year of the JSD program who have completed an LLM or JSM degree at Stanford and have been admitted to the JSD program will be entitled to terminal graduate registration (“TGR”) status, which allows students to register at a reduced tuition rate and pay for additional units. JSD students who earned the LLM degree at another university are not entitled to TGR status until they have both earned 35 units and been in residence for three quarters at Stanford.

• In exceptional circumstances and with the express permission of their faculty advisor, students may petition to take more than 9 units elsewhere in the university.

• Because of their special course and thesis requirements, JSD candidates cannot avail themselves of the “clinical quarter.

children.name: Stanford LLM or JSM (SPILS) Conferred
children.desc:
Credits earned to meet the Stanford-based LLM or JSM (SPILS) requirements will count toward 35 of the 44 units required for the JSM degree. quarter units.

• At least 26 of those 35 units must be in Law School courses

• JSD candidates may not take any courses that required during the entry quarter of the LAW-JD curriculum. Coursework required during the second quarter of the JD may be taken with departmental permission only.
Students who have earned a Stanford LLM/JSM must meet the following enrollment criteria:

• First-Year Enrollment: 3 courses of at least 3 units each, for a minimum of 9 but no more than 15 units. Students wishing to take more than 9 units must secure the approval of their faculty advisor, and the law-school registrar must be so informed. And no student may take more than 7 units in a single quarter.

• No more than 9 units toward JSD residency may be taken outside of the Law School

children.name: LLM Earned Outside Stanford
children.desc:
JSD students who earned the LLM degree at an institution other than Stanford may not apply external coursework toward completion of the JSD. They must complete a total of 44 residency units toward the degree.

• No more than 9 units toward JSD residency may be taken outside of the Law School

• JSD candidates may not take any courses that required during the entry quarter of the LAW-JD curriculum. Coursework required during the second quarter of the JD may be taken with departmental permission only.
Students who earned the LLM outside of Stanford must meet the following enrollment criteria:

• First-Year Enrollment: Complete a total of 35 units distributed over 3 quarters in residence, and enroll in no fewer than 9 units per quarter.

• Second-Year Enrollment: 3 courses of at least 3 units each, for a minimum of 9 but no more than 15 units. Students wishing to take more than 9 units must secure the approval of their faculty advisor, and the law-school registrar must be so informed. During this second year, they may take more than 7 units in a single quarter

• No more than 9 units toward JSD residency may be taken outside of the Law School

rules.name: Colloquium Requirement
rules.desc: Regular attendance and participation (including presenting JSD research at various stages) in a faculty-led colloquium is required of all first-year JSD candidates and all other JSD candidates who are in residence at Stanford.
